questions.question_english: Under FR 9(4), “Cadre” is defined as:

The strength of a service or a part of a service sanctioned as a separate unit
The authorized scale of pay for a particular post

Appointed on an ad-hoc basis for a project
Appointed substantively to a permanent post

questions.explanation_english: Under Fundamental Rule 13, a government servant acquires a lien on a post automatically when they are appointed substantively to a permanent post. questions.question_english: According to FR 15, can a government servant be transferred from one post to another?
options_english: No, an employee cannot be transferred outside their parent administrative district under any circumstances

No, transfer of a government servant is strictly a punitive measure following formal disciplinary proceedings

questions.explanation_english: Under Fundamental Rule 15, the competent administrative authority holds full legal powers to transfer a government servant from one post to another in public interest. questions.question_english: A regular employee is unauthorizedly absent for 30 days. The Head of Office decides to adjust this period against the employee’s accumulated Earned Leave balance without receiving any leave application. Is this action correct as per rules?

questions.question_english: Review the following statements about initial pay fixation under FR 22. I. Initial pay is generally fixed at the minimum cell of the applicable level. II. GPF में न्यूनतम अंशदान कर्मचारी की परिलब्धियों का 6% है। III. विवाह, शिक्षा और बीमारी जैसे निर्दिष्ट उद्देश्यों के लिए अग्रिम लिया जा सकता है। IV. GPF खाते पर सरकार द्वारा समय-समय पर घोषित ब्याज मिलता है। सही कथन कौन-से हैं?
options_hindi: I, II और III
II, III और IV
I, III और IV
I, II, III और IV
questions.question_english: Review these statements about the General Provident Fund (GPF): I. GPF is applicable to all employees joining service after 1st January 2004. II. The minimum subscription to GPF is 6% of the subscriber’s emoluments. III. Advances can be drawn from the GPF for specific purposes like marriage, education, and illness. IV. GPF accounts earn an interest rate declared by the Government periodically. Which of the statements are correct?
options_english: I, II and III
II, III and IV
I, III and IV
I, II, III and IV
questions.explanation_english: General Provident Fund rules apply only to employees appointed prior to 1st January 2004. The minimum subscription is 6% of emoluments, and accounts earn government-declared interest rates periodically. Subscribers can draw advances or non-refundable withdrawals for specified financial needs like education, housing, marriage, and medical treatment under GPF regulations
questions.explanation_hindi: GPF सामान्यतः 1 जनवरी 2004 से पहले नियुक्त पात्र कर्मचारियों पर लागू होता है। न्यूनतम अंशदान 6% है, निर्दिष्ट उद्देश्यों के लिए अग्रिम लिया जा सकता है और ब्याज दर सरकार समय-समय पर घोषित करती है।
key_facts: Answer key: (B)
Correct option: II, III and IV
सही विकल्प: II, III और IV
